answer: A farm faking 481 aliases needs 481 separate search logs, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Truffle hunter licence with woodland search logs is the check: searches logged in one wood across seasons. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The ridge record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the quill entry is checkable by anyone, and the canyon window closes before a farm can catch up.
